resources.string: ALL YOUR AI STUDIO APPS IN ONE PLACE
Manage, Organize & Download Your AI Apps.
No APK available for this project. Please complete an Android APK build first.

Google AI Studio does not expose a public API to list your private My Apps or directly download APKs. Open Google AI Studio in your browser, export your project ZIP or link its GitHub repository, and manage everything securely here.
This artifact contains an Android App Bundle (.aab), not an APK. Android App Bundles are designed for Google Play distribution and cannot be installed directly on a phone like an .apk file.
